retrievalProfile.description: A centered full-body portrait set against a high-contrast golden sunset with wide-tracked serif typography flanking the subject.
triggerTerms: centered figure with wide-spaced serif text
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required
urban or industrial settings are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tall, centered female figure in a metallic gold swimsuit stands on a reflective water surface. The background is a dramatic, saturated sunset with orange and yellow clouds blending into a starry blue sky at the top. The lighting is highly directional, creating a warm, bronzed glow on the skin and sharp highlights on the clothing texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography split across the central axis
Reflection in water mirroring the subject's pose
Color gradient from deep orange at the horizon to teal-blue at the zenith

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject centered, occupying approximately 80% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's torso and the bright horizon line behind the waist.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down the vertical line of the body to the reflection, then outward to the text on either side.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced negative space on the left and right, filled with atmospheric clouds and typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Golden yellow and amber (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal and navy blue (upper sky and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the oranges; high value contrast between the bright horizon and the dark upper sky.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard classical proportions
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme tracking to create a sense of luxury and space.
graphicDevices: Horizontal split of text across the subject
Subtle lens flares and star glints

candidateDirections.reason: Classical Roman proportions with sharp serifs suitable for luxury branding.
The standard for cinematic and high-end display serif typography.
High contrast strokes provide a fashion-forward editorial look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body portrait of a woman in a metallic gold knit swimsuit standing on a calm, reflective water surface. The background is a dramatic sunset with vibrant orange and yellow clouds at the horizon, transitioning into a dark teal sky with scattered stars at the top. The lighting should be warm and golden, highlighting the subject's silhouette and skin texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a classical serif font like Cinzel, add all-caps text in the middle-third of the image. Split the text so it appears on both the left and right sides of the subject. Apply extreme tracking (wide spacing) and set the color to a dark bronze or black with a very subtle outer glow to ensure legibility against the bright background.

verificationChecks: Is the text split evenly across the subject?
Is the tracking wide enough to feel airy?
Does the skin tone match the golden background?
Is there a clear reflection in the water?

adjustableVariables: Amount of star detail in the upper sky
Texture of the swimsuit (knit vs. solid metallic)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Seamless blending between subject and background lighting

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the pose
Ensure the horizon line is perfectly horizontal
Verify the text is legible against the clouds
Confirm the reflection aligns with the subject's feet
Check that the color transition from orange to teal is smooth
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered subject + High-contrast sunset + Split wide-tracked serif text = Luxury Pop Aesthetic
